text:
Alice H: Heads-up — customer ACME (PO required) reports a partial refund/credit not matching ledger after a mid-cycle downgrade.
Ben P: Invoice id?
Alice H: INV-2026-ACME-77. They say the credit issued was ~€82 but expected ~€70. Attaching their PO notes: tax exempt on one line.
Carla (Finance): can you paste the invoice line items? rough example will help.
Alice H: Sure, from the invoice PDF they sent (redacted):

```
items:
- product_plan_monthly x1 @ 100.00 EUR (tax rate: 20%)
- professional_addon x1 @ 50.00 EUR (tax rate: 0% - PO line exemption)
billing period: 2026-02-01 to 2026-03-01
downgrade effective: 2026-02-16 (50% proration)
```

Alice H: Customer expected proration: plan and addon both prorated 50% with line-level tax applied, so:
`expected_credit = (100*0.5)*(1+0.20) + (50*0.5)*(1+0.00) = 60 + 25 = 85 EUR gross -> credit ~85 (minus rounding)`
Dave S: the system currently applies the invoice-level tax setting when creating credit notes for legacy PO-mapped customers. if the invoice-level tax was 20% it ends up adding VAT to the addon line incorrectly.
Ben P: that explains the discrepancy but the numbers don't match Alice's 82 vs 85 — rounding/ledger posting could be different.
payments-bot: ledger-alert: mismatch detected for INV-2026-ACME-77 -> credit_note CN-998 created: posted_amount=82.40 EUR, expected_gross=85.00 EUR
Carla (Finance): repro steps I used in sandbox: 1) create customer with PO and line-level tax exemption 2) create invoice with one taxed line + one exempt line 3) simulate mid-cycle downgrade (50%) 4) call POST /v1/invoices/INV-*/credit_notes -> observe tax applied at invoice-level. I can share sandbox link.
Dave S: thanks. quick technical note: our credit engine picks tax_rate from invoice.tax_profile if invoice.is_po_legacy=true. new PO flow uses per-line TaxInfo correctly.  
Ben P: can Eng patch to prefer line.tax_rate when present? looks like config toggle will do.
Carla (Finance): workaround for now: create manual credit note via Console and set per-line adjustments to zero VAT for exempt lines, then reconcile the ledger. I'll document steps in the ticket.
Alice H: customer wants ETA. can we scope a rollback or config change? pinging @eng-platform in the thread (please read). :pray:
Dave S: tagging eng-platform. short-term: docs + manual credits. medium-term: fix credit calculation to consult line.tax_rate if present. I'll open ENG-CR-374 and link.
Ben P: marking P1. Carla to own finance side reconciliation, Dave to own eng fix. I'll notify CS to message customer and offer manual credit now.
Carla (Finance): I'll publish a one-pager on steps + the sample SANDBOX curl snippet:  
```bash
# reproduce (sandbox)
curl -X POST "https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-2026-ACME-77/credit_notes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test_..." \
  -d '{"reason":"mid-cycle downgrade","effective_date":"2026-02-16"}'
```
Carla (Finance): putting notes in ticket now. will update when ENG-CR-374 has a PR.
Alice H: thanks all :thumbsup:
